Q0691

“The task of the humane is to promote the benefit of all…” — Mozi (Mozi, Impartial Love II)

Verified English quotation. Primary source: Mozi, Impartial Love II. Theme: good.

Quotes / Mozi / Q0691

English

The task of the humane is to promote the benefit of all under Heaven and to eliminate its harm.
Thinker Mozi
School Mohism
Source Mozi, Impartial Love II
Theme Good

How to read this passage

Across 4 recurring voices here (notably Dhammapada and Philippa Foot), good is framed through Early Buddhism and Analytic Philosophy. Some passages define good; others warn how it fails; still others relocate it inside habit, community, or language. This passage enters that discussion through good, humanity.

Concepts in this quote

Good
Good appears in this archive as a live philosophical concern—not a slogan. These verified English passages show how thinkers treat good as a problem of judgment, practice, or explanation.
Humanity
Humanity names both the species and the moral quality of being humane—bridging anthropology and ethics.
